facts.claim: Resilient Lady (Virgin Voyages): Entered service 2023; 110,338 GT; 2770 guests (lower berth / double occupancy); 290 m length; Lady class.
Resilient Lady reimagines cruising: adults-only, modern design, smart cabins, immersive venues, vibrant entertainment & intimate nightlife, luxury awaits.
Hop aboard one of Resilient Lady’s unforgettable Aegean and Caribbean sailings. See what awaits onshore and on board.
Resilient Lady is a cruise ship that is operated by Virgin Voyages.
At 110,000 GT and measuring 278 metres (912 ft) long for a capacity of 2,770 passengers, she was built with similar proportions to her older sisters Scarlet Lady and Valiant Lady.

catalogSpecs.description: Lady-class; cruise ship operated by its listed cruise line; entered service 2023; 110,338 GT; approx. 2,770 guests at double occupancy.
